scope: Original-signal native oscillator reconstruction; no reference assets or proprietary implementation

method.metric: Energy outside physically in-band carrier +/- integer*modulator FFT bins relative to energy inside those bins. Magnitudes checked independently against Bessel coefficients times native decimator transfer.
method.limitations: Near FFT precision floor comparisons are not physical rejection guarantees. One sine source/carrier family; no broad certification of FM, FMX, self feedback, arbitrary wavetables, noise, output filter or effects. Latency changes source phase/feedback relationships. 2x residual aliasing and 4x output-decimator transition leakage remain.

reconstruction.design: Original cardinal windowed sinc, 4 phases, 48 coefficients/phase, Kaiser beta 8, unity DC per phase, exact delayed integer phase

componentBenchmark.note: Local best of 3 trials, one sine oscillator at 48 kHz, one/two distinct external PM sources. Includes table lookup/warps/decimation; no polyphony/host CPU guarantee. Sequential runs are timing-sensitive.

outputFilterDiagnostic.method: Independent analytic continuous sine PM sampled at 4x and passed through the existing two output FIR decimators; no source hold/interpolator or wavetable lookup
